title: ContextGatherRequest
description: Message published by the MemoFlow API to the RabbitMQ queue `ctx.gather.requests`. Consumed by the context engine (an n8n workflow) to gather connector context for a planning job. Correlated to the response via `job_id`.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Additive-only changes within v1.

job_id.description: planning_jobs._id — the correlation key used on both hops. The CE MUST echo it in every result chunk.

user_id.description: PG users.id that owns the planning job.

connectors.description: The user's active, selected connectors. An empty array means no connector context was requested/available.

requested_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the API published the request.

provider.description: Connector provider — the MemoFlow ConnectorProvider allowlist.

mcp_url.description: Null by design. The context engine resolves the live MCP server itself from `provider` + `composio_account_id` (it holds its own Composio credentials).

composio_account_id.description: Composio connected-account id for this user+provider. Not a secret on its own; the CE uses it with its Composio credentials to reach the MCP.
